ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: At the origin in the diagram there are four candidate coordinate axes. b is the horizontal line, d is the vertical line, c is the diagonal line from upper left to lower right, and a is the diagonal line from lower left to upper right; near the origin and on the right side, the curve presents a shape symmetric along a diagonal direction. Then reason: In the equation, y appears only as y^2, so the graph is symmetric about the x-axis. This axis of symmetry in the diagram corresponds to c, so c is the x-axis; a, which is perpendicular to it and passes through the origin, is the y-axis.
